comment: questpgr.c find_quest_artifact() line 101 and find_qarti() line 81, through quest.c on_goal() on revisits of the quest goal level. A debug Valkyrie wishes for the Orb of Fate before visiting the goal level (so the level makes no second artifact), stashes it in a wished sack, visits the goal level, creates a newt there, leaves for the locate level and genocides newts with an uncursed scroll. On her return goto_level() runs kill_genocided_monsters(), which leaves the dead newt in fmon, and onquest() -> on_goal() searches the floor (nothing), then the monster inventories, skipping the dead newt at 101. She then drops the sack, leaves and returns: the floor search recurses into the sack, and find_qarti() returns the Orb from the recursive call at 81. The final keys dismiss any --More--.
